construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation created directly for this isolated build

input.synthetic: Required literal true; all fixture assets, logs and inspections are fictitious
input.fixture_seed: Integer random seed for synthetic telemetry fixture reproduction
input.preferences: interests maps exact, case-sensitive tags to integer weights 1..10; excluded_work_order_ids, excluded_asset_ids and excluded_tags are arrays; limit is integer 1..50
input.work_orders: ERP/MES-style JSON records with unique work_order_id, asset_id, title, tags, status (open/in_progress/closed), safety_critical and nonempty invented maintenance_logs
input.sensor_csv: Embedded time-series CSV string with strict columns reading_id,work_order_id,asset_id,timestamp,metric,value,unit,lower,upper,safety_critical; boolean text is true/false
input.quality_inspections: Unique inspection_id with work_order_id, asset_id, timezone-aware timestamp, inspector_id, procedure_revision, decision, rationale, metric, value, unit, lower, upper and safety_critical

shared_schema.output: One JSON object: schema_version, status, synthetic, recommendations, eligible_count, excluded, escalations, notice. Errors: schema_version, status=error and error message, exit 2.
shared_schema.validation: One validate boundary normalizes CSV, checks strict object fields, unique IDs, referential integrity, required per-order evidence, timezone-aware timestamps, finite numeric values, unit compatibility and ordered tolerances. Inspection pass/fail must agree with inclusive tolerances.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single functionality: shared validator -> normalized linked manufacturing records -> exclusion enforcement and weighted preference ranking -> grounded JSON recommendations.
Independent safety scan over all validated evidence -> human review queue records, even for excluded or closed work orders and when no interests match.

behavior.ranking: Sum weights for unique matched declared work-order tags. No matches yields no recommendation. Descending score then ascending work_order_id; apply limit only after exclusions.
behavior.explanations: Deterministic matched tags and numeric contributions; full sensor and quality decision evidence, plus maintenance log IDs. No inference of equipment safety or quality authorization.
behavior.traceability: Demonstrative ISO 9001-style traceability links each recommendation to recorded inspection decision, inspector, procedure revision, timestamp, rationale and measurement. No compliance certification claims.
behavior.safety: Out-of-tolerance sensor or inspection values escalate if either evidence or associated work order is safety-critical. Escalations are pending_human_review records routed to human_safety_reviewer, not delivered notifications.
behavior.fixtures: Clearly labeled synthetic data. Six plausible readings generated with random.Random(59), uniform ranges [(50,60),(60,65),(4,5.5),(4,7),(8,10),(8,10)], rounded to three decimals; deliberately abnormal press vibration and torque exercise human escalation.

included: Synthetic ERP/MES JSON and time-series CSV

test_outcomes.cli: Verified single JSON object, status ok, exit 0; two recommendations and three human escalation records
test_outcomes.error_paths: Missing file, missing argument, malformed JSON, duplicate JSON keys and invalid schema produce JSON status error and exit 2
test_outcomes.fixture_validation: Seeded telemetry reproducibility test passed after correcting fixture values to match random.Random(59)
